<!DOCTYPE html>

<title>Damosal Invitational 2026 · Puerto Los Cabos</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Montserrat:wght@200;300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --nv:#08141F;--nm:#0F1F2E;--nl:#172B3D;
  --gd:#C9A04A;--gl:#E0BC72;--gp:#F0D99A;
  --cr:#F5F0E4;--cd:#DDD5BE;
  --tl:#0C98A8;--t2:#0D7A88;--sd:#C4956A;--su:#C05D38;--mu:#7A8EA0;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;background:var(--nv);color:var(--cr);overflow-x:hidden}
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:300;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 56px;transition:all .5s}
nav.sc{background:rgba(8,20,31,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,160,74,.15)}
.nb{display:flex;align-items:center;text-decoration:none}
.nb img{height:34px;width:auto;filter:brightness(0) invert(1)}
.nl{display:flex;gap:32px;list-style:none}
.nl a{font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:3px;color:rgba(245,240,228,.6);text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .3s}
.nl a:hover{color:var(--gd)}
.nc{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--nv);background:var(--gd);text-decoration:none;padding:11px 24px;transition:background .3s}
.nc:hover{background:var(--gl)}
.hero{position:relative;height:100vh;min-height:720px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.hbg{position:absolute;inset:0;background:url('https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/683639b5ec10703bbb9ecaee/1754676174697-KQVBKKA860XB9DBPRCF6/GolfVistaCourse_1500x1000.jpg') center/cover no-repeat;will-change:transform}
.hov{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(8,20,31,.45) 0%,rgba(8,20,31,.18) 35%,rgba(8,20,31,.65) 72%,rgba(8,20,31,1) 100%)}
.htl{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 15%,rgba(12,152,168,.18) 0%,transparent 55%);pointer-events:none}
.hc{position:relative;text-align:center;padding:0 24px;animation:fup 1.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}
.hey{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:6px;color:var(--tl);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:28px}
.hey::before,.hey::after{content:'';width:40px;height:1px;background:var(--tl);opacity:.7}
.ht{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(80px,12vw,148px);font-weight:300;line-height:.88;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-3px;text-shadow:0 2px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.ht .it{font-style:italic;color:var(--gp)}
.hs{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(18px,2.5vw,26px);font-style:italic;font-weight:300;color:rgba(245,240,228,.85);letter-spacing:4px;margin-top:14px}
.hr{width:1px;height:52px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,var(--gd),transparent);margin:28px auto}
.hm{display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;border:1px solid rgba(201,160,74,.35)}
.hp{font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(245,240,228,.9);padding:12px 28px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.hp+.hp{border-left:1px solid rgba(201,160,74,.35)}
.dt{width:4px;height:4px;background:var(--gd);border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0}
.tbd{background:var(--t2);padding:14px 56px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:40px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ti{font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:3px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);text-transform:uppercase}
.ts{width:3px;height:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);border-radius:50%}
.inn{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:120px 56px}
.ey{font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:6px;color:var(--tl);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:18px}
.st{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(38px,4.5vw,60px);font-weight:300;line-height:1.1;color:var(--cr)}
.st em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gd)}
.gr{width:48px;height:1px;background:var(--gd);margin:24px 0;opacity:.7}
.bt{font-size:14px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.95;color:var(--cd);margin-bottom:16px}
.tc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;align-items:center}
.aq{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:21px;font-style:italic;font-weight:300;color:rgba(12,152,168,.95);border-left:2px solid var(--tl);padding:6px 0 6px 22px;margin:28px 0}
.sg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px}
.sca{background:var(--nm);padding:32px 26px;border-top:2px solid transparent;transition:border-color .3s,background .3s,transform .25s;cursor:default}
.sca:hover{border-top-color:var(--tl);background:var(--nl);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.sn{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:52px;font-weight:300;color:var(--gd);line-height:1}
.sl{font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--mu);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:8px}
.pb{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.pb1{height:55vh;min-height:380px}
.pb2{height:62vh;min-height:420px}
.pb3{height:50vh;min-height:340px}
.pbb{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;transition:transform .6s ease}
.pb:hover .pbb{transform:scale(1.02)}
.pbo{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bg1{background-image:url('https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/683639b5ec10703bbb9ecaee/1754673433313-Y45HZ75PYAP8YISFH0GV/PLC+-+Nicklaus+2+-+Hole+4.jpg');background-position:center 40%}
.bo1{background:linear-gradient(to right,rgba(8,20,31,.72) 0%,rgba(8,20,31,.1) 50%,rgba(8,20,31,.55) 100%)}
.bt1{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(12,152,168,.18) 0%,transparent 50%)}
.p1t{position:absolute;left:56px;bottom:48px;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(26px,3.8vw,50px);font-weight:300;font-style:italic;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.5);line-height:1.2}
.p1t span{color:var(--gp)}
.p1c{position:absolute;right:56px;bottom:52px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:3px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);text-transform:uppercase;text-align:right}
.bg2{background-image:url('https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/683639b5ec10703bbb9ecaee/1754673599370-F4LIKUYSHSDCVXWH8YXZ/Golf2_1500x1000.jpg')}
.bo2{background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(8,20,31,.15) 0%,rgba(8,20,31,.82) 100%)}
.prz{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 56px 52px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px}
.pn{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(52px,9vw,104px);font-weight:300;color:#fff;line-height:1}
.ps{font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--gl);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:8px}
.pd{font-size:14px;font-weight:300;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);max-width:360px;line-height:1.85;text-align:right}
.bg3{background-image:url('https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/683639b5ec10703bbb9ecaee/1754673505900-2UQWS7D48U20LYMGMV7P/Golf1_1500x1000.jpg');background-position:center 60%}
.bo3{background:rgba(8,20,31,.42)}
.p3c{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;text-align:center}
.p3t{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(36px,5vw,64px);font-weight:300;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.p3s{font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--gp);text-transform:uppercase}
/* FORMAT */
.s-fm{background:var(--nm)}
.ft{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;margin-bottom:60px;align-items:start}
/* Bullet points — grid for perfect alignment */
.rl{list-style:none;margin-top:18px}
.rl li{font-size:13px;font-weight:300;color:var(--cd);padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;line-height:1.7}
.rl li::before{content:'';min-width:5px;width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--tl);border-radius:50%;margin-top:7px;flex-shrink:0}
.rl li b{color:var(--cr);font-weight:500}
.daygrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px;margin-bottom:2px}
.daycard{background:var(--nv);padding:36px 32px;border-top:2px solid var(--tl);transition:background .3s,transform .25s;cursor:default}
.daycard:hover{background:var(--nl);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.daycard-num{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--tl);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:12px}
.daycard-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:300;color:var(--cr);margin-bottom:16px}
.daycard p{font-size:13px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:10px}
.daycard ul{list-style:none;margin-top:4px}
.daycard ul li{font-size:12px;font-weight:300;color:var(--cd);padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;line-height:1.6}
.daycard ul li::before{content:'';min-width:4px;width:4px;height:4px;background:var(--tl);border-radius:50%;margin-top:7px;flex-shrink:0}
.score-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:2px;margin-top:28px}
.score-card{background:var(--nm);padding:20px 16px;text-align:center;border-top:2px solid transparent;transition:border-color .3s,background .3s,transform .25s;cursor:default}
.score-card:hover{border-top-color:var(--gd);background:var(--nl);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.score-val{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:32px;font-weight:300;color:var(--gd);line-height:1}
.score-lbl{font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--mu);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:6px}
.score-pts{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--tl);margin-top:4px}
.ranking-banner{background:var(--nl);margin-top:2px;padding:28px 40px;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rank-item{text-align:center;padding:0 32px;flex-shrink:0}
.rank-pos{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:42px;font-weight:300;color:var(--gd);line-height:1}
.rank-lbl{font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--mu);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:4px}
.rank-sep{width:1px;height:48px;background:rgba(201,160,74,.2);flex-shrink:0}
.rank-desc{flex:1;min-width:260px;padding-left:40px;font-size:13px;font-weight:300;color:var(--cd);line-height:1.85;border-left:1px solid rgba(201,160,74,.2)}
.rank-desc strong{color:var(--cr);font-weight:500}
.rules-strip{background:var(--nl);padding:20px 32px;margin-top:2px;display:flex;gap:32px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.rule-item{font-size:12px;font-weight:300;color:var(--cd);display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.rule-item::before{content:'';min-width:5px;width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--gd);border-radius:50%;margin-top:4px;flex-shrink:0}
/* DYNAMICS — 8 cards 4-col */
.s-dy{background:var(--nv)}
.dhd{text-align:center;margin-bottom:60px}
.dg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:2px}
.dc{background:var(--nm);padding:28px 24px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background .3s,transform .25s;cursor:default;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:280px}
.dc::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--tl),var(--gd));transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .5s}
.dc:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}
.dc:hover{background:var(--nl);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.dic{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:40px;font-weight:300;color:rgba(201,160,74,.25);margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1;transition:color .3s}
.dc:hover .dic{color:var(--gd)}
.dty{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--tl);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px}
.dnm{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:300;color:var(--cr);margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.3}
.dd{font-size:12px;font-weight:300;color:var(--mu);line-height:1.75;flex:1}
.dbot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.dpr{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gd);text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid rgba(201,160,74,.3);padding:5px 10px;white-space:nowrap}
.dlogo{height:24px;width:auto;max-width:72px;object-fit:contain;flex-shrink:0;display:block}
/* HOLES */
.s-ex{background:var(--nm)}
.exhd{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;margin-bottom:60px;align-items:start}
.htabs{display:flex;gap:2px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:2px}
.htab{padding:12px 20px;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu);background:var(--nv);cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;border:none;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif}
.htab.active,.htab:hover{color:var(--gd);border-bottom-color:var(--gd);background:var(--nl)}
.hd{background:var(--nv);padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr;gap:0;align-items:stretch;transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;overflow:hidden}
.hd-left{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:260px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a1520 0%,#0d1f30 50%,#081218 100%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px 8px}
.hd-left img{display:none}.hd-left svg{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:240px;display:block;transition:transform .5s}.hd:hover .hd-left svg{transform:scale(1.04) translateY(-3px)}
.hd-right{padding:40px 48px}
.hbig{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:100px;font-weight:300;color:rgba(201,160,74,.12);line-height:1;transition:color .4s}
.hd:hover .hbig{color:rgba(201,160,74,.22)}
.hbr{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:4px;color:var(--tl);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px}
.hpr{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:36px;font-weight:300;color:var(--cr);margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.2}
.htp{display:inline-block;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gd);border:1px solid rgba(201,160,74,.4);padding:6px 14px;margin-bottom:16px}
.hde{font-size:14px;font-weight:300;color:var(--cd);line-height:1.9}
.hva{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:28px;font-weight:300;color:var(--gd);margin-top:20px}
.hva span{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:var(--mu);margin-left:6px;letter-spacing:1px}
.exft{background:var(--nl);padding:40px 48px;margin-top:2px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;border-top:1px solid rgba(201,160,74,.2)}
.exft-t{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:26px;font-style:italic;font-weight:300;color:var(--cr)}
.exft-t strong{font-style:normal;color:var(--gd);font-weight:400}
/* AUDIENCE */
.s-au{background:var(--nv)}
.ac{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px}
.br{margin-bottom:20px}
.bl{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px}
.blt{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:var(--cd)}
.bp{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:300;color:var(--gd)}
.btr{height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.bf{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--tl),var(--gd));width:0;transition:width 1.5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.ab{background:rgba(12,152,168,.08);border:1px solid rgba(12,152,168,.28);padding:26px 28px;margin-top:36px}
.abt{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:4px;color:var(--tl);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px}
.ab p{font-size:13px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.85;color:var(--cd)}
.bm{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:68px;font-weight:300;color:var(--gd);line-height:1}
.bms{font-size:10px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--mu);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:6px}
/* AGENDA */
.s-ag{background:var(--nm)}
.agr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px;margin-top:48px}
.ad{background:var(--nv);padding:44px 36px}
.adt{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--tl);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px}
.ad h3{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:32px;font-weight:300;color:var(--cr);margin-bottom:28px}
.ai{display:flex;gap:20px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.at{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gd);min-width:58px;letter-spacing:1px}
.ade{font-size:13px;font-weight:300;color:var(--cd);line-height:1.7}
.ade b{color:var(--cr);font-weight:500}
/* SPONSORS */
.s-sp{background:var(--nv)}
.sph{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;margin-bottom:56px;align-items:end}
.lg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:2px}
.lc{background:var(--nm);height:90px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px 16px;transition:background .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:default}
.lc::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--tl),var(--gd));transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform .45s}
.lc:hover{background:var(--nl)}
.lc:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.lph{border:1px dashed rgba(201,160,74,.2);background:transparent}
.lph:hover{background:rgba(201,160,74,.04)}
.phl{font-size:8px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:3px;color:rgba(201,160,74,.3);text-transform:uppercase;text-align:center}
.lc img{max-height:58px;max-width:110px;width:auto;height:auto;object-fit:contain}
.spn{margin-top:22px;font-size:11px;font-weight:300;color:var(--mu);font-style:italic;text-align:center}
.sbar{height:4px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--t2),var(--gd),var(--su),var(--sd))}
/* CTA */
.s-ct{background:var(--nm);position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:center}
.ctbg{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:700px;font-weight:300;color:rgba(12,152,168,.03);line-height:1;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.ctw{position:relative;max-width:680px;margin:0 auto}
.cte{font-size:9px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:6px;color:var(--tl);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px}
.ctt{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(40px,5.5vw,64px);font-weight:300;line-height:1.15;color:var(--cr);margin-bottom:22px}
.ctt em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gd)}
.ctd{font-size:14px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.95;color:var(--cd);margin-bottom:48px}
.wab{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--gd);color:var(--nv);text-decoration:none;padding:18px 44px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;transition:background .3s,transform .2s}
.wab:hover{background:var(--gl);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.wab svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0}
.ctc{margin-top:36px;font-size:12px;font-weight:300;color:var(--mu)}
.ctc a{color:var(--gd);text-decoration:none}
footer{background:var(--nv);padding:40px 56px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.fti{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;margin-bottom:18px}
.fl{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:6px;color:var(--gd);text-transform:uppercase}
.fm{font-size:10px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--mu);text-align:center;line-height:1.9}
.fr{font-size:10px;font-weight:300;color:var(--mu);text-align:right;line-height:1.9}
.fr a{color:var(--tl);text-decoration:none}
.fcr{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);padding-top:16px;text-align:center;font-size:9px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:2px;color:rgba(122,142,160,.55);text-transform:uppercase}
@keyframes fup{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(32px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s ease}
.rv.up{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
@media(max-width:960px){
  nav{padding:16px 24px} .nl{display:none}
  .inn{padding:80px 24px}
  .tc,.ft,.exhd,.ac,.sph,.agr,.daygrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}
  .dg{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .hd{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hd-left{min-height:200px}
  .score-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .lg{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .p1t{left:24px;bottom:32px} .p1c{display:none}
  .prz{left:24px;right:24px;padding:0 0 32px}
  .tbd{gap:16px;padding:12px 24px;flex-direction:column}
  .fti{flex-direction:column;text-align:center} .fr{text-align:center}
  .ranking-banner{flex-direction:column;gap:20px;padding:24px}
  .rank-item{padding:0}.rank-sep{width:80px;height:1px}
  .rank-desc{padding-left:0;border-left:none;border-top:1px solid rgba(201,160,74,.2);padding-top:20px}
  .rules-strip{gap:16px}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .lg{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .sg{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hm{flex-direction:column;border:none}
  .hp+.hp{border-left:none;border-top:1px solid rgba(201,160,74,.35)}
  .score-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .dg{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<nav id="nav">
  <a href="#" class="nb"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Grupo Damosal"></a>
  <ul class="nl">
    <li><a href="#torneo">El Torneo</a></li>
    <li><a href="#formato">Formato</a></li>
    <li><a href="#dinamicas">Dinámicas</a></li>
    <li><a href="#marcas">Marcas</a></li>
    <li><a href="#agenda">Agenda</a></li>
  </ul>
  <a href="#contacto" class="nc">Ser Patrocinador</a>
</nav>

<section class="hero">
  <div class="hbg" id="himg"></div>
  <div class="hov"></div><div class="htl"></div>
  <div class="hc">
    <div class="hey">Puerto Los Cabos &nbsp;·&nbsp; 2026</div>
    <h1 class="ht">DAMOSAL<br><span class="it">Invitational 2026</span></h1>
    <p class="hs">Golf · Exclusividad · Conexión</p>
    <div class="hr"></div>
    <div class="hm">
      <div class="hp"><span class="dt"></span>36 Holes</div>
      <div class="hp"><span class="dt"></span>Scramble + Best Ball</div>
      <div class="hp"><span class="dt"></span>Invite Only</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="tbd">
  <span class="ti">Jack Nicklaus &amp; Greg Norman Courses</span>
  <span class="ts"></span>
  <span class="ti">Sea of Cortez · Baja California Sur</span>
  <span class="ts"></span>
  <span class="ti">En colaboración con Cabo Collective A.C.</span>
</div>

<section style="background:var(--nv)" id="torneo">
  <div class="inn">
    <div class="tc">
      <div class="rv">
        <p class="ey">El Evento que nos Define</p>
        <h2 class="st">Donde los líderes<br>se <em>encuentran</em></h2>
        <div class="gr"></div>
        <p class="bt">El Damosal Invitational nace de una visión: crear espacios donde los mejores líderes empresariales de la región se encuentran, compiten y forjan relaciones que trascienden el campo de golf.</p>
        <p class="bt">Una experiencia de dos días en Puerto Los Cabos — uno de los campos de golf más icónicos de México, diseñado por Jack Nicklaus y Greg Norman. No hay boletos. La única forma de entrar es ser invitado.</p>
        <div class="aq">«Puedes estar seguro,<br>nos lo tomamos personal.»</div>
        <p class="bt" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--mu)">Grupo Damosal · Consultores en Seguros · +7 años · +18,000 personas aseguradas · +700 empresas</p>
      </div>
      <div class="rv" style="transition-delay:.2s">
        <div class="sg">
          <div class="sca"><div class="sn counter" data-t="140">0</div><div class="sl">Invitados Selectos</div></div>
          <div class="sca"><div class="sn counter" data-t="36">0</div><div class="sl">Holes · 2 Days</div></div>
          <div class="sca"><div class="sn counter" data-t="18">0</div><div class="sl">Hoyos Patrocinados</div></div>
          <div class="sca"><div class="sn">1</div><div class="sl">Manera de Entrar</div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="pb pb1">
  <div class="pbb bg1"></div><div class="pbo bo1"></div><div class="bt1"></div>
  <div class="p1t">Uno de los campos más<br><span>icónicos de México</span></div>
  <div class="p1c">Puerto Los Cabos Golf Club<br>Nicklaus II · San José del Cabo, BCS</div>
</div>

<section class="s-fm" id="formato">
  <div class="inn">
    <div class="ft">
      <div class="rv">
        <p class="ey">El Formato</p>
        <h2 class="st">Competencia<br>de <em>alto nivel</em></h2>
        <div class="gr"></div>
        <p class="bt">Dos rondas de 18 hoyos con salida en escopetazo. Todos al campo al mismo tiempo — energía colectiva, networking estratégico y competencia real en cada hoyo.</p>
        <p class="bt" style="margin-top:8px;color:var(--mu);font-size:12px">Sistema Stableford · Puntuación acumulada Día 1 + Día 2.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="rv" style="transition-delay:.15s">
        <ul class="rl">
          <li><b>Scramble Best Ball:</b> Todos los jugadores tiran; el equipo elige la mejor bola para la siguiente posición.</li>
          <li><b>Participación garantizada:</b> Cada jugador pone al menos 3 salidas por ronda — todos aportan.</li>
          <li><b>Sistema Stableford:</b> Hole in One 10 pts · Eagle 5 pts · Birdie 3 pts · Par 2 pts · Bogey 1 pt · Doble+ 0 pts.</li>
          <li><b>Cierre Día 1 — Hoyo 18:</b> 140 jugadores, un tiro desde 140 yardas. El más cercano gana $50,000 en efectivo.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="daygrid rv" style="transition-delay:.1s;margin-bottom:2px">
      <div class="daycard">
        <div class="daycard-num">Día 1</div>
        <div class="daycard-title">Scramble en Parejas <span style="font-size:14px;color:var(--mu)">(Foursomes)</span></div>
        <p>Equipos de 2 jugadores dentro de grupos de 4. Cada jugador ejecuta su golpe y el equipo selecciona la mejor posición.</p>
        <ul>
          <li>Juego dinámico, colaborativo y ágil</li>
          <li>Participación garantizada: mínimo 3 salidas por jugador</li>
          <li>Enfoque en integración y construcción de relaciones</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="daycard">
        <div class="daycard-num">Día 2</div>
        <div class="daycard-title">Low Ball (Best Ball) <span style="font-size:14px;color:var(--mu)">con Rotación</span></div>
        <p>Nuevas parejas dentro de cada foursome. Cada jugador compite con su propia bola; se registra el mejor score del equipo por hoyo.</p>
        <ul>
          <li>Mayor exigencia competitiva individual</li>
          <li>Rotación diseñada para potenciar el networking</li>
          <li>Balance ideal entre estrategia y desempeño</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="score-grid rv" style="transition-delay:.15s">
      <div class="score-card"><div class="score-val">−3</div><div class="score-lbl">Hole in One</div><div class="score-pts">10 puntos</div></div>
      <div class="score-card"><div class="score-val">−2</div><div class="score-lbl">Eagle</div><div class="score-pts">5 puntos</div></div>
      <div class="score-card"><div class="score-val">−1</div><div class="score-lbl">Birdie</div><div class="score-pts">3 puntos</div></div>
      <div class="score-card"><div class="score-val" style="color:var(--cd)">E</div><div class="score-lbl">Par</div><div class="score-pts">2 puntos</div></div>
      <div class="score-card"><div class="score-val" style="color:var(--mu)">+1</div><div class="score-lbl">Bogey</div><div class="score-pts">1 punto</div></div>
      <div class="score-card"><div class="score-val" style="color:var(--mu)">+2</div><div class="score-lbl">Doble o más</div><div class="score-pts">0 puntos</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="ranking-banner rv" style="transition-delay:.2s">
      <div class="rank-item"><div class="rank-pos">1°</div><div class="rank-lbl">Primer Lugar</div></div>
      <div class="rank-sep"></div>
      <div class="rank-item"><div class="rank-pos">2°</div><div class="rank-lbl">Segundo Lugar</div></div>
      <div class="rank-sep"></div>
      <div class="rank-item"><div class="rank-pos">3°</div><div class="rank-lbl">Tercer Lugar</div></div>
      <div class="rank-desc">Clasificación <strong>individual</strong> por puntuación acumulada de los dos días — Día 1 (Scramble) + Día 2 (Low Ball). El jugador con mayor puntaje total se corona campeón.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="rules-strip rv" style="transition-delay:.25s">
      <div class="rule-item">Grupos de 4 jugadores conformados estratégicamente</div>
      <div class="rule-item">Tarjetas cruzadas entre equipos</div>
      <div class="rule-item">Firmas obligatorias al cierre de cada ronda</div>
      <div class="rule-item">Handicaps ajustados para garantizar equidad competitiva</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="pb pb2">
  <div class="pbb bg2"></div><div class="pbo bo2"></div>
  <div class="prz">
    <div><div class="pn">$3.9M</div><div class="ps">MXN · Pool total · Hole in One</div></div>
    <div class="pd">Longest Drive · Closest to Pin · Precision Drive · Putting Challenge — cada hoyo, una emoción. Cada patrocinador, su propia experiencia.</div>
  </div>
</div>

<section class="s-dy" id="dinamicas">
  <div class="inn">
    <div class="dhd rv">
      <p class="ey">Dinámicas del Torneo</p>
      <h2 class="st" style="text-align:center">Cada hoyo,<br>un <em>reto distinto</em></h2>
      <div class="gr" style="margin:24px auto"></div>
      <p class="bt" style="text-align:center;max-width:600px;margin:0 auto">Dinámicas en el tee, en el fairway, en el green y en el hoyo. Cada patrocinador dueño de su experiencia frente a 140 tomadores de decisión.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="dg rv" style="transition-delay:.1s">

      <div class="dc">
        <div class="dic">I</div>
        <div class="dty">Dinámica en el Tee</div>
        <div class="dnm">Longest Drive</div>
        <p class="dd">El drive más largo del torneo en el fairway designado. Potencia y precisión frente a 140 líderes.</p>
        <div class="dbot"><span class="dpr">Patrocina tu hoyo</span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="dc">
        <div class="dic">II</div>
        <div class="dty">Hole in One · Par 3</div>
        <div class="dnm">Reloj Rolex</div>
        <p class="dd">Meter el hoyo en uno desde el tee en el par 3 asignado. La elegancia del tiempo como el premio más exclusivo al golpe más difícil del golf.</p>
        <div class="dbot">
          <span class="dpr">Reloj Rolex · Premio</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="dc">
        <div class="dic">III</div>
        <div class="dty">Precision Drive</div>
        <div class="dnm">10 Relojes Garmin</div>
        <p class="dd">Los 10 drives más precisos dentro de la zona designada ganan un reloj Garmin Golf. Tecnología al servicio del desempeño.</p>
        <div class="dbot">
          <span class="dpr">Garmin Golf</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="dc">
        <div class="dic">IV</div>
        <div class="dty">Closest to Pin</div>
        <div class="dnm">Set PXG + Fitting</div>
        <p class="dd">El tiro más cercano al pin en el hoyo asignado gana un set de palos PXG nueva generación con fitting personalizado incluido.</p>
        <div class="dbot">
          <span class="dpr">PXG Newest Gen</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="dc">
        <div class="dic">V</div>
        <div class="dty">Dinámica en el Green</div>
        <div class="dnm">Putting Challenge</div>
        <p class="dd">Un putt de larga distancia. El jugador más cercano al hoyo gana el premio del patrocinador.</p>
        <div class="dbot"><span class="dpr">Patrocina tu green</span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="dc">
        <div class="dic">VI</div>
        <div class="dty">Hole in One · Par 3</div>
        <div class="dnm">Tesla Model Y</div>
        <p class="dd">Meter el hoyo en uno desde el tee en este par 3 designado entrega las llaves de un Tesla Model Y en el acto.</p>
        <div class="dbot">
          <span class="dpr">$959K MXN</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="dc">
        <div class="dic">VII</div>
        <div class="dty">Hole in One · Par 3</div>
        <div class="dnm">Carrito de Golf</div>
        <p class="dd">Hole in one en el par 3 asignado. El tiro perfecto gana un carrito de golf Hardy Carts & Equipment. Rentals · Sales · Service.</p>
        <div class="dbot">
          <span class="dpr">Hardy Carts</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="dc">
        <div class="dic">VIII</div>
        <div class="dty">Cierre Día 1 · Hoyo 18</div>
        <div class="dnm">$50,000 en Efectivo</div>
        <p class="dd">Los 140 jugadores reunidos. Un único tiro desde 140 yardas. Sin red de seguridad. El más cercano se lleva $50,000 MXN.</p>
        <div class="dbot"><span class="dpr">Patrocinador Diamante</span></div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="s-ex" id="experiencia">
  <div class="inn">
    <div class="exhd">
      <div class="rv">
        <p class="ey">Ownership de Experiencia</p>
        <h2 class="st">Cada hoyo,<br>un escenario <em>propio</em></h2>
        <div class="gr"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="rv" style="transition-delay:.15s">
        <p class="bt">Como patrocinador, no solo pones tu logo — eres dueño de la experiencia completa en ese hoyo: la dinámica, el premio, la emoción. 140 líderes de primer nivel vivirán tu marca en primera persona durante dos días completos.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="rv" style="transition-delay:.1s">
      <div class="htabs" id="htabs">
        <button class="htab active" data-i="0">Tesla</button>
        <button class="htab" data-i="1">Rolex</button>
        <button class="htab" data-i="2">Eight Sleep</button>
        <button class="htab" data-i="3">PXG Golf</button>
        <button class="htab" data-i="4">Garmin</button>
        <button class="htab" data-i="5">Hardy Carts</button>
        <button class="htab" data-i="6">+11 Hoyos</button>
      </div>
      <div class="hd" id="hdisp">
        <div class="hd-left" id="hole-visual">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 800 380" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <!-- Car body gradient: white to light gray -->
    <linearGradient id="bodyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#F0F0F0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D8D8D8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Roof gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="roofGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E8E8E8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C0C0C0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Glass gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="glassGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1a2a3a" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0d1821" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- Wheel gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="wheelGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#555"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#222"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#111"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <!-- Rim gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="rimGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#CCC"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#888"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <!-- Shadow -->
    <radialGradient id="shadowGrad" cx="50%" cy="0%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0.35"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <!-- Light bar glow -->
    <linearGradient id="lightBar" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="30%" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="glow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softShadow">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="8" stdDeviation="12" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.4"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="330" rx="320" ry="18" fill="url(#shadowGrad)"/>

  <!-- ═══ MAIN CAR BODY ═══ -->
  <!-- Lower body sill -->
  <path d="M115 275 Q118 282 130 285 L670 285 Q682 282 685 275 L680 270 L120 270 Z" fill="#B8B8B8"/>

  <!-- Main body panel (side view) -->
  <path d="M105 230 
           Q108 270 120 275 
           L680 275 
           Q692 270 695 230 
           L695 210 
           Q690 195 665 190 
           L580 185 
           Q540 130 510 118 
           Q470 108 440 107 
           L310 107 
           Q280 108 260 115 
           Q230 122 210 145 
           L185 185 
           L135 190 
           Q110 195 105 210 Z" 
        fill="url(#bodyGrad)" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>

  <!-- Roof panel -->
  <path d="M210 145 Q240 122 280 113 L440 107 Q470 108 510 118 Q540 130 580 185 L460 185 
           Q430 130 390 120 L340 120 Q300 125 270 155 Z" 
        fill="url(#roofGrad)"/>

  <!-- Hood slope -->
  <path d="M105 210 L135 190 L185 185 L200 195 L200 230 L105 230 Z" fill="#E8E8E8"/>

  <!-- Trunk/rear slope -->
  <path d="M695 210 L665 190 L600 185 L590 195 L590 230 L695 230 Z" fill="#E8E8E8"/>

  <!-- ═══ WINDOWS ═══ -->
  <!-- Front windshield -->
  <path d="M214 152 Q242 125 278 116 L310 114 L305 180 L200 185 Z" fill="url(#glassGrad)" opacity="0.9"/>
  <!-- Rear window -->
  <path d="M510 120 Q540 132 575 185 L480 185 Z" fill="url(#glassGrad)" opacity="0.9"/>
  <!-- Side windows (3 panels) -->
  <path d="M308 115 L380 112 L378 178 L306 180 Z" fill="url(#glassGrad)" opacity="0.85"/>
  <path d="M383 112 L440 111 L440 178 L381 178 Z" fill="url(#glassGrad)" opacity="0.85"/>
  <path d="M443 111 L490 112 L488 178 L443 178 Z" fill="url(#glassGrad)" opacity="0.85"/>
  <!-- Window chrome dividers -->
  <line x1="381" y1="112" x2="380" y2="178" stroke="#DDD" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="443" y1="111" x2="443" y2="178" stroke="#DDD" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- ═══ TESLA FRONT LIGHT BAR (2025 Juniper style) ═══ -->
  <rect x="108" y="192" width="90" height="4" rx="2" fill="url(#lightBar)" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <rect x="108" y="193" width="90" height="2" rx="1" fill="#fff" opacity="0.95"/>

  <!-- Front headlight units -->
  <path d="M110 188 Q112 185 125 184 L168 184 Q175 185 178 190 L178 198 Q175 202 168 202 L120 202 Q112 200 110 195 Z" fill="#333" opacity="0.4"/>
  <path d="M113 190 L170 190 L172 196 L113 196 Z" fill="#DDD" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- ═══ TESLA REAR LIGHT BAR ═══ -->
  <rect x="600" y="192" width="92" height="4" rx="2" fill="#EE3333" opacity="0.85" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <rect x="600" y="193" width="92" height="2" rx="1" fill="#FF4444" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- ═══ DOOR HANDLES (flush) ═══ -->
  <rect x="248" y="215" width="36" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D0D0D0"/>
  <rect x="395" y="215" width="36" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D0D0D0"/>
  <rect x="490" y="215" width="36" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D0D0D0"/>

  <!-- ═══ BODY HIGHLIGHT LINE ═══ -->
  <path d="M135 240 Q400 232 665 240" stroke="#FFF" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- ═══ FRONT BUMPER ═══ -->
  <path d="M105 230 Q100 250 103 265 L120 270 L120 265 Q118 255 115 240 Z" fill="#C8C8C8"/>
  <!-- Front lower grille/diffuser -->
  <rect x="103" y="255" width="80" height="12" rx="2" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <rect x="107" y="258" width="24" height="6" rx="1" fill="#333"/>
  <rect x="135" y="258" width="24" height="6" rx="1" fill="#333"/>
  <rect x="163" y="258" width="14" height="6" rx="1" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- ═══ REAR BUMPER ═══ -->
  <path d="M695 230 Q700 250 697 265 L680 270 L680 265 Q682 255 685 240 Z" fill="#C8C8C8"/>
  <rect x="617" y="255" width="80" height="12" rx="2" fill="#1a1a1a"/>

  <!-- Tesla wordmark on rear -->
  <text x="645" y="252" font-family="'Montserrat',sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="600" fill="#CCC" letter-spacing="2">TESLA</text>

  <!-- ═══ FRONT WHEEL ═══ -->
  <circle cx="215" cy="290" r="52" fill="#111"/>
  <circle cx="215" cy="290" r="50" fill="url(#wheelGrad)"/>
  <!-- Tire sidewall -->
  <circle cx="215" cy="290" r="48" fill="none" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="8"/>
  <circle cx="215" cy="290" r="38" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <!-- Rim spokes (5-spoke Aero style) -->
  <g transform="translate(215,290)">

var tabs=document.querySelectorAll('.htab');
tabs.forEach(function(tab){

    tabs.forEach(function(t){t.classList.remove('active');});
    tab.classList.add('active');
    var d=holes[parseInt(tab.getAttribute('data-i'))];
    var disp=document.getElementById('hdisp');
    disp.style.opacity='0';disp.style.transform='translateY(8px)';
    setTimeout(function(){
      document.getElementById('hnum').textContent=d.num;
      document.getElementById('hbrand').textContent=d.brand;
      document.getElementById('hprize').textContent=d.prize;
      document.getElementById('htype').textContent=d.type;
      document.getElementById('hdesc').textContent=d.desc;
      document.getElementById('hval').innerHTML=d.val;

      if(vis && d.img==='tesla-svg'){
        vis.style.background='linear-gradient(135deg,#0a1520 0%,#0d1f30 50%,#081218 100%)';
        vis.style.padding='16px 8px';

        vis.style.background='url(https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/683639b5ec10703bbb9ecaee/1754673433313-Y45HZ75PYAP8YISFH0GV/PLC+-+Nicklaus+2+-+Hole+4.jpg) center 40%/cover no-repeat';
        vis.style.padding='0';
      }
      disp.style.opacity='1';disp.style.transform='translateY(0)';
    },200);
  });
});
document.getElementById('hdisp').style.transition='opacity .25s,transform .25s';

var nav=document.getElementById('nav');
window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){nav.classList.toggle('sc',window.scrollY>60);},{passive:true});

var himg=document.getElementById('himg');
window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){himg.style.transform='translateY('+(window.scrollY*0.3)+'px)';},{passive:true});

var revIO=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){entries.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('up');});},{threshold:0.1});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv').forEach(function(r){revIO.observe(r);});

var cntIO=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
  entries.forEach(function(e){
    if(e.isIntersecting){
      var el=e.target,target=parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-t')),current=0,step=Math.ceil(target/40);
      var timer=setInterval(function(){current=Math.min(current+step,target);el.textContent=current;if(current>=target)clearInterval(timer);},35);
      cntIO.unobserve(el);
    }
  });
},{threshold:0.3});
document.querySelectorAll('.counter').forEach(function(c){cntIO.observe(c);});

var barIO=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
  entries.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.querySelectorAll('.bf').forEach(function(b){b.style.width=b.getAttribute('data-w')+'%';});});
},{threshold:0.3});
var bs=document.getElementById('barsec');if(bs)barIO.observe(bs);

document.querySelectorAll('.dc,.sca,.score-card,.daycard').forEach(function(c){
  c.style.transition='transform .25s,background .3s,border-color .3s';
  c.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){c.style.transform='translateY(-3px)';});
  c.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){c.style.transform='translateY(0)';});
});
